questions.stem: Why is the removal of faeces from the body not considered excretion?

options.text: Because faeces leave through the anus, not the kidneys
Because faeces are solid and excretory products must be liquid
Because faeces contain undigested food that was never part of cell metabolism
Because faeces are not toxic to the body

questions.explanation: Excretion is specifically the removal of metabolic waste products made inside cells. Faeces contain undigested food that was never absorbed into cells, so their removal is called egestion, not excretion.
